actions.reason: C0001 shows strong biological support: RNA pathway enrichment with large effect sizes and BAP1 mutation enrichment (OR=12.46, q=0.0029). No significant technical confounding per-set. Cross-modal consistency is weak but RNA is the primary driver, and the set has a defensible identity. Known label echo is low. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

C0002 shows strong biological support: RNA pathway enrichment with large effect sizes and multiple significant CNV features (chr7p, chr20q, chr7q, chr2p). Cross-modal consistency is moderate with high resampling ARI (0.704) and low PAC (0.434). Although technical confounding is present (BP site, GE, LightSpeed16), it does not invalidate the biological distinctiveness. Known label echo is low. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

C0003 lacks significant biological support across all modalities: no RNA pathways, no WXS mutations, no CNV features significant after FDR. Cross-modal consistency is moderate but driven mainly by CT, which is a technical modality. Strong technical confounding is present (manufacturer, scanner, kernel, slice thickness). The set does not have a defensible biological identity, and no supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists. Drop is appropriate.

C0004 shows only partial biological support: RNA has some significant pathways but WXS and CNV are not FDR-significant. Cross-modal consistency is weak with low resampling ARI (0.412) and high PAC (0.791), and 0% of patients have all positive modalities. No significant technical confounding, but the evidence is insufficient to establish a distinct biological identity. No supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists. Drop is appropriate.
